about.title: About the BREAKthrough set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: BREAKthrough is a XY expansion released on 4 November 2015. It has 165 cards: 162 in the main set and 2 secret rares and 1 alternate versions. There are also 139 reverse holos.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 162 main set cards), the Master set (301 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 304 cards, adding the 2 secret rares and 1 alternate versions).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
